title: Co-op on a leaning pawn: it stands up first (DPC 0.9.176-dev7)
intro: The stand-up-first fix, now for co-op. Have a second controller connected (player 2). Tavern, playing the Arisen, co-op off. SAVE FIRST. Press End to start.

steps.text: 1/4 Wait until the pawn row shows IN INTERACTION for one pawn (leaning). Then End.
2/4 (automatic) Starting co-op with player 2 on the leaning pawn: it should stand up first, then go to player 2.
3/4 Player 2: walk the pawn around with the second controller. Does it move? Player 1: move the Arisen too. End.
4/4 Co-op off. Tell Claude whether the pawn stood up and player 2 could move it. End.

probes.who: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; return D and (D.state.active and ('playing '..tostring(D.state.pawn_name)) or 'Arisen') or ''
probes.pawns: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; local pm=sdk.get_managed_singleton('app.PawnManager'); local l=pm and pm:call('get_PawnCharacterList'); if not (D and l) then return '' end; local t={}; for i=0,l:call('get_Count')-1 do local c=l:call('get_Item',i); local n='?'; pcall(function() n=tostring(c:call('get_ActionManager'):get_field('Fsm'):call('getCurrentNodeName(System.UInt32)',0)) end); t[#t+1]=i..':'..(D.R.busy_interact(c) and 'IN INTERACTION ' or '')..n end; return table.concat(t,' / ')
probes.spots: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; return D and tostring(D.R.lean_spots) or ''
probes.errs: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'dev_status/DirectPawnControl.json'); return ok and d and d.errors
probes.coop: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; if not D then return '' end; local c=D.R.cp; return 'coop '..tostring(D.state.active and D.state.pawn_name or '-')..' p2side '..tostring(c and c.on)
